reviews.text: Thank you, Eloi Cardoso dos Santos. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Thank you, Daniela Avalos, for taking the time to share your review with us! Come visit us again soon at Arcaplanet stores!

I have been shopping in Nigra for years now, exceptional girls. I don't understand the reorganization of the shelves with what criteria they were managed. I NO LONGER UNDERSTAND ANYTHING. I GIVE 2 STARS ONLY FOR THIS REASON.
The service and customer care are truly top-notch. I've always been satisfied with my purchases.
I often go good products and varied choice

I wasn't satisfied. After I had to wait a while for the cashier. I don't understand how this other customer was placed in front of me, and you even made the cashier go away. As if it were me who wasn't there waiting and as if I didn't even exist.
I'm very satisfied with their advice and how they welcome us every time we come in. And I've realized that all the stores have the same approach. My cat is happy and I'm even happier 😃 …
Arcaplanet in Piazzale Nigra, Milan, is an excellent store, but its strong point is the sales assistant, Serena...an angel with kindness, courtesy, and expertise. Thank you.
Best place ever thanks to the super knowledgeable and courteous staff!
Very helpful staff, I will definitely be back
Kindness and competence in this shop
